name: Fluoroscopy
description: Real-time X-ray; covers barium studies, VCUG, HSG, sialography, arthrography, myelography, sinography/fistulography, loopogram, defecography

name: Cone Beam CT
description: Lower-dose volumetric CT, common in dental/maxillofacial and IR

name: MR Angiography
description: Contrast or flow-based MR of vasculature

name: Nuclear Medicine (general scintigraphy)
description: Bone scan, HIDA, renal scan, V/Q scan, thyroid scan, gastric emptying, tagged RBC, etc.

name: Interventional Radiology (procedural)
description: Image-guided biopsy, drainage, ablation, embolization, vertebroplasty/kyphoplasty, vascular access, pain procedures -- see notes for sub-typing by procedure

name: Panoramic / Dental Radiography
description: OPG, cephalometric, intraoral -- only if dental imaging is in scope

name: Radiation Therapy Simulation CT
description: CT acquired for radiotherapy planning -- only if RT planning imaging is in scope

name: Other / Unclassified
description: Fallback for a modality not yet in this registry -- flag for review
